name: Get Smart Campaigns by Lead ID
summary: Shows every Smart Campaign that a specific lead is enrolled in.
whenToUse: When you want to check which Smart Campaigns a lead is currently in (or was routed into).

query.name: batchSize
query.label: Batch size (max per page)
query.hint: Optional. Maximum records per response (max 300). Leave blank for the default.

response.description: Array of Smart Campaign memberships: campaignId and enrollment details.
